verdict.rationale: gstack ships its own agent-driven skill-creation paths. /skillify codifies a /scrape intent into a reusable script that future calls run directly. Domain skills let an agent save per-site skill notes, and those can be promoted from per-project to global. Both paths are narrow, and the evidence shows no general spec, template, or meta-skill for authoring and packaging an arbitrary new SKILL.md end to end; dev mode only symlinks a checkout for contributors. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose skill-authoring meta-skill or template/spec, packaging/registration steps for new skills, and hands-on corroboration of agent-authored skills.
